instructions: PRECISION STANDARD: Every dictionary definition must be self-contained and mathematically precise. Do not make a definition depend on unexplained proof-frame vocabulary, provenance adjectives, or bookkeeping modifiers. Drop unnecessary modifiers rather than defining them. If a term cannot be defined without importing a local proof frame, it does not belong in this dictionary. Define terms whose meaning workers should use consistently; prefer atomic words and genuinely atomic multiword phrases.
title: Canonical terms
